summary: NY TAKTIKK AS (org. no. 990 674 728) is a private limited company (AS) based in Fredrikstad, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2006-12-27. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.120 (Utvikling og salg av byggeprosjekter); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 434 690 and net income was NOK 94 324. Board chair: Espen Lien. Also: LEI 549300GNAIIHHRU5TU09.
